evidence.naturalness: Model utterances are standard beginner English: Hello, My name is Arman, Nice to meet you, How are you, Goodbye.
evidence.persian: Translations use natural conversational Persian and avoid malformed ezafe forms.
evidence.pos: hello/goodbye are interjections and name is a noun; multiword functions are represented as chunks rather than assigning false POS to component tokens.
evidence.chunks: Nice to meet you and My name is ... are taught as complete functional units.
evidence.accepted_answers: Alternatives are natural beginner responses; no merely understandable but awkward forms are accepted.
evidence.prerequisites: Every scored target is exposed or explicitly taught earlier in the same lesson/chapter.
evidence.reading: Three short target-language reading inputs require extraction or interpretation of name/greeting meaning.
evidence.pronunciation: Word stress, contraction shadowing and question intonation are explicitly noticed or practiced.

review_note: Series 001 has no obligations due from an earlier series. New obligations begin at Series 002.
